name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the oldest merged PR with known issues. It tests the tool on real, proven problems without risking new code. The trade-off is delayed feedback on fresh PRs, but we learn faster from past mistakes.

name: Gauge
text: PR-Agent in shadow mode on old PRs won’t expose fresh routing or prompt failures—those only surface when new inputs hit the engine. Instead, run it on *open* PRs with known issues to catch regressions in real time; the risk is minor noise, but the signal is immediate. Settle it with a 48-hour trial on the next open PR with documented prompt drift.
